name: dex-demo
description: Local and remote DEX operator pattern that installs the DEX module and prepares endpoints for the web app and automation tests.
use_case: Run the Xian DEX under known contract names so wallets, the SnakX web app, automation services, and integration tests can rely on the same AMM surface.

starter_flows.name: local
starter_flows.summary: Run a local indexed node, install the DEX module with the local-demo recipe, and seed a demo liquid pair.

steps.title: Create and start the local indexed node
notes: Run these commands from the xian-stack checkout.
The base localnet starts without the DEX. Install the module next.

steps.title: Install the DEX module
commands: uv run xian module install dex --recipe local-demo --stack-dir ../xian-stack
notes: Run this command from the xian-cli checkout.
This deploys the pinned DEX module bundle and seeds the demo pool.

starter_flows.name: remote
starter_flows.summary: Deploy a small shared network, then install the pinned DEX module against the service RPC with an explicit operator wallet.

steps.title: Create the shared-network bundle
commands: uv run xian network create dex-remote --template consortium-3 --chain-id dex-remote-1 --generate-validator-key
notes: Run this command from the xian-cli checkout.
The consortium template is the recommended remote operator posture for a shared DEX network.

steps.title: Deploy and verify the remote nodes
notes: Run these commands from the xian-deploy checkout with your prepared inventory.
Use a BDS node for indexed reads, DEX web inspection, and automation services.

steps.title: Install the DEX module
commands: uv run xian module install dex --recipe production --rpc-url http://<rpc-host>:26657 --chain-id dex-remote-1 --deployer-private-key <bootstrap-wallet-private-key> --stack-dir ../xian-stack
notes: Run this command from the xian-cli checkout.
Production-like installs should configure real pairs and LP tokens explicitly instead of seeding demo liquidity.
